summary: Shoshone County, Idaho St. Joe National Forest lookout: pole tower in the 1930s, R-6 tower replaced it, auctioned 2013, removed 2014; ruins and footings remain.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 20-foot pole tower, later an R-6 flat cab on a 20-foot treated timber tower
facts.status_note: Removed in 2014 by a private owner; timbers and cement footings remain at the site.

staffing.status: staffed until the 1995 season, then emergency status

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FireLookout.com says the original lookout was first used in 1933; the Kresek-credited list and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1936 for the 20-foot pole tower. The story reports both.
FireLookout.com gives 1975 for the R-6 timber tower; the Kresek-credited list and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1974.
The GSA auction bid closed October 24, 2013 and the FFLA report says sold late 2013; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 2014 for the sale. The story reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the core story (L-4 pole tower, R-6 replacement, 2013 GSA auction, 2014 removal, ruins on site) and the disagreements are small (1933 vs 1936 first lookout, 1974 vs 1975 R-6 tower, 2013 vs 2014 sale), all reported in the story. Re-erection is unverified: the Idaho Fire Lookouts page points to the owners' Facebook page for the removal and rebuild, which returned only its title when fetched. A Gazette Record article ('Huckleberry makes a move', gazetterecord.com) was returned by search but was HTTP 429 twice and is unread; it may say where the tower stands now. Access: no source gives an access level; only the Drive-Up tag, so facts.access is omitted. Staffing 'as_of 1995' is the end of staffing per FireLookout.com; the Idaho known-staff list runs to 1980 but is not labelled complete. Height 6.1 m is the 20-foot figure converted. No photos added.
